description: Editorial headings; selected verbatim terminal output. Countdown accelerated, waits and package-manager chatter omitted. source_time refers to volume-full.cast.

frames.title: 01  A normal attached ext4 volume
frames.body:
$ lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINTS
NAME     SIZE FSTYPE  MOUNTPOINTS
sda        1G ext4    /mnt/data
vda       25G         
|-vda1    24G ext4    /
|-vda14    4M         
|-vda15  106M vfat    /boot/efi
`-vda16  913M ext4    /boot
vdb      488K iso9660 

$ df -h /mnt/data
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/sda        974M  181M  727M  20% /mnt/data

frames.title: 02  Existing application files
frames.body:
$ find /mnt/data -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort
/mnt/data/README.txt
/mnt/data/config/application.env
/mnt/data/releases/current.bin
/mnt/data/releases/payload.bin
/mnt/data/uploads/sparse.bin

frames.title: 03  One command; review the plan
frames.body:
$ curl -fsSL http://127.0.0.1:8765/reformat.sh | bash -s -- /mnt/data
NAME
    PATH     SIZE FSTYPE MOUNTPOINTS
sda /dev/sda   1G ext4   /mnt/data
preserve data volume: /dev/sda on /dev/sda; final pool zfsify_7636b41dbce7430b at /mnt/data
[ ext4 ] -> [ smaller ext4 | temporary ZFS ] -> [ ZFS mirror | temporary ZFS ] -> [ full ZFS ]

frames.title: 04  Same mount point; all content verified
frames.body:
$ findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,TARGET --target /mnt/data
zfsify_7636b41dbce7430b/data zfs    /mnt/data

$ (cd /mnt/data && sha256sum --check /root/data.sha256)
README.txt: OK
config/application.env: OK
releases/payload.bin: OK
releases/current.bin: OK
uploads/sparse.bin: OK

frames.title: 05  Healthy pool; automatic expansion enabled
frames.body:
$ zpool list -o name,size,alloc,free,health
NAME                      SIZE  ALLOC   FREE    HEALTH
zfsify_7636b41dbce7430b   992M   181M   811M    ONLINE

$ zpool get autoexpand
NAME                     PROPERTY    VALUE   SOURCE
zfsify_7636b41dbce7430b  autoexpand  on      local

frames.title: 06  Metadata preserved; no reboot needed
frames.body:
$ getfattr --only-values -n user.demo /mnt/data/README.txt
getfattr: Removing leading '/' from absolute path names
preserved
PASS: hashes, hard links, ACLs, xattrs. Root stays ext4; no reboot.
